title: wildmat: apply pattern matching at ingestion and gossipsub subscription
description:
## Why
Needed by stoa-efbe068a. Ingestion must filter articles using wildmat patterns.

NOTE: Gossipsub was removed in commit bcd4026. The gossipsub subscription derivation part of this issue is obsolete. The ingestion filtering part remains valid.

## What
- Ingestion: replace exact-set lookup with wildmat_list_match against each newsgroup in the article's Newsgroups header
- Startup: log which groups will be accepted based on configured patterns

## Obsolete (gossipsub removed)
- ~~Gossipsub topic derivation: extract hierarchies from positive patterns~~
- ~~Subscribe to stoa.hier.* topics implied by patterns~~
